title: Safehouse and Deadline
author: Yara Fairweather
blurb: Ivo Zhou, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
